summary: OceanFirst Financial Corp. filed an 8-K announcing the completion of a previously disclosed sale of $1.3 billion of multifamily loans acquired via the Flushing Financial merger. The portfolio, largely NYC rent-regulated, was sold at a price consistent with initial valuation estimates. The repositioning reduces rent-regulation exposure to under 2.5% of total assets. BofA Securities advised; Morgan Lewis provided legal counsel. No specific price per share, premium, or terms were disclosed. This is a balance-sheet repositioning, not a special-situation transaction. Watch for second-quarter earnings for further details on financial impact.
